name: Lightspeed Loyalty
oneLiner: Loyalty and marketing tools that run inside Lightspeed Restaurant POS, so points and rewards are tracked on the same system that takes orders and payments.
bestFor: Restaurants, cafes and bars already on Lightspeed Restaurant that want loyalty without a separate vendor.

customers.name: Miriam / 6R Hospitality Group (New York) - Lightspeed Restaurant customer

updates.text: Launched Lightspeed AI, conversational assistants inside Lightspeed Restaurant (and Retail), with more features promised through 2026.
Q3 product release added Tempo (service pacing from kitchen display data) and Tasks (digital opening and closing checklists) to Lightspeed Restaurant.

features: Points earned on purchases, redeemed at the POS or online
Birthday campaign with a yearly one-time reward
Time Away campaign giving bonus points to guests who haven't visited in 30 days
Customer segments by spend and visit frequency
Email and SMS campaigns with a drag-and-drop builder (Advanced Marketing)
Automated flows for first purchase, birthdays and lapsed guests
Tiered programs with higher earn rates for VIP groups
Loyalty app / web sign-up for guests

pricing.text: Lightspeed's US restaurant loyalty pricing page lists Essential at $189/month and Premium at $399/month; prices vary by region (for example AUD pricing in Australia).

notes: lightspeedhq.com could not be fetched; facts come from search snippets of Lightspeed pages and release notes. Dropped from the original: 'loyalty included in all plans' (sources conflict; the UK page says loyalty can be bought as an add-on), the $69 Starter plan (third-party sources say it was dropped), the retail Core $149 plan, and the Toast $185/month comparison. Merchant Maverick reports the original L-Series Loyalty is no longer sold to new customers, who get Advanced Loyalty and Marketing (powered by Marsello) instead; I couldn't confirm this on a Lightspeed page. The three customers are Lightspeed Restaurant POS customers; their stories don't confirm they use the loyalty module, so the review calls them Lightspeed Restaurant customers.
